purpose: Phase 1 of the historical backtest: for every ledger card, decide whether its trigger can be mechanized against FREE historical data, and write the machine spec. Phase 2 consumes 'ready' (and optionally 'partial') entries.

status_legend.ready: all needed series free; trigger expressible as-is
status_legend.partial: mechanizable only with a stated substitution (e.g. surprise vs naive forecast instead of vs consensus) or with limited history
status_legend.blocked: required data is paid/unavailable; parked until a feed exists

sources.fred: FRED API (key in env FRED_API_KEY) - decades of daily/monthly macro
sources.noaa: NOAA CPC ONI index (ENSO), degree days
sources.cftc: CFTC Commitments of Traders free historical files
sources.binance: Binance public API perp funding history (2019+)
sources.cboe: CBOE published put/call CSVs (limited free history)
sources.atlfed: Atlanta Fed GDPNow historical vintages CSV
sources.manual: small hand-curated event table (dates only), publicly documented

conventions.surprise_naive: Where the original card compares a release to CONSENSUS (paid history), the backtest substitutes 'surprise vs naive forecast' = actual minus 12m trailing mean change, in trailing sigma units. Substitution is stated on every such card and in the published methodology.
conventions.observe: Grading = did the THEN-clause bias hold over the stated lag window? target is a Yahoo ticker (or FRED series), direction is the biased sign; hit = sign(target return over window) == direction.
conventions.fire_dedup: A card cannot re-fire during its own open observation window.

interactions_note: All 12 X-cards are conjunctions of base cards; each becomes backtestable automatically when its components are ready. Ready now: X-001 (MKT-002+MKT-001), X-003 (EMP-001+RAT-001), X-004 partial, X-006 (INF-004+INF-003), X-008 blocked (MKT-004), X-012 (RAT-005+EMP-003). FX-component X-cards (X-007, X-011) wait on FX cards not present in the base list.
gates_note: G1 (regime w), G2 (convergence C), G3 (Hurst H) are all computable from Yahoo baskets - they enter phase 2 as conditioning variables so per-card hit rates can also be reported gate-on vs gate-off.

tally.comment: ready+partial = 38/48 (79%) of base cards can enter the backtest; blocked cards are parked with named blockers, which is itself published methodology.
